page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top, one text column in the centre, and marginal notes at the left margin beside lines 7 and 8 of the text ("7. Secunda", "8. Tertia"). Digitiser's banner at the bottom right is left out.

main_text.p: nonnullis. Cæteros autem sic à laicis distinguebant ut non essent quidem ἐν κλήρῳ κατα-γεγραμμένοι, quoniam χειροθεσίαν non habebant, ut loquitur 2. canon Chalced. synod. qui etiam dicuntur οἱ ἐν ἐκκλησιαστικῷ τάγματι ejusdem synod. can. 6. & κατάλεγ-μένοι can. 10. & εἰς ἐκκλησίαν πλήντες can. 20. sed illa generali appellatione dicerentur ἐν τῷ κανόνι ἐξεταζόμενοι, ut Nicen. synod. can. 14. & οἱ τῶν κανόνων Chalced. synod. can. 2. Secundo κανῶν λειτουργίας, à quibusdam Græcis Theologis & Latinis recentioribus certa benedictionis cœnæ mysticæ formulam denotat. Tertio κανὼν est positus; pro fidelium episcoporum & præsertim Martyrum catalogo, quorum in solemnibus precibus memoria celebrabatur; cujus consuetudinis aliqua vestigia in Græcæ & Latinæ liturgiæ canone adhuc retinentur. Hunc autem olim etiam morem fuisse ex quorundam veterum Theologorum scriptis liquido constat, & ex recentioribus scriptoribus Nicephorus præsertim multis explicat lib. 14. cap. 25. & 26. ubi contentionem illam narrat de Chrysostomi nomine in Mysticas tabulas referendo, inde factum arbitror, ut canonizati dicti sint, quorum memoria publico Ecclesiæ consensu celebrabatur; unde orta tandem divorum 7. Secunda 8. Tertia

page.notes: The Greek words are printed in a small, partly worn type and are transcribed as far as legible; the Greek in the first lines and the lower part of the column are doubtful. The word at the end of the column, "vorum", is printed with a capital V-like initial and is read as "vorum" (continuing on the next page as "divorum"). Marginal notes "7.Secunda" and "8.Tertia" are the printed side notes.
